article.title: Where rejection of plaint does not preclude presentation of fresh plaint.
article.content: The rejection of the plaint on any of the grounds hereinbefore mentioned shall not of its own force preclude the plaintiff from presenting a fresh plaint in respect of the same cause of action.
article.html:
13Where rejection of plaint does not preclude presentation of fresh plaint.

Order 7, Rule 13

The rejection of the plaint on any of the grounds hereinbefore mentioned shall not of its own force preclude the plaintiff from presenting a fresh plaint in respect of the same cause of action.
